Four arrested in Delhi for alleged gang rape and murder of a minor

Four individuals have been arrested in Delhi in connection with the alleged gang rape and murder of a 16-year-old girl. The arrests were made after reviewing over 50 CCTV footages. One report indicated that the investigation involved identifying a tempo with a blurred license plate, as there were no eyewitnesses to the crime. The accused were apprehended following a thorough investigation.
